description:
Listen to El-P from Run the Jewels talk about Prince's influence 
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

El-P from Run the Jewels talks about the powerful effect Prince had on his life. “Prince is one of the biggest influences and one of the biggest heroes in my life,” El-P explains in this interview recorded at The Current in 2017.

You can find that full interview on The Current's website: https://www.thecurrent.org/feature/2017/03/04/theft-of-the-dial-run-the-jewels
